steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the initially shown event type to RFQ and configure whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title so the create screen is valid.
Apply the RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Attempt to add the same mapped product twice with the requested quantity; the step records whether the product is merged, refused, or added twice.
Assert the observable retained-two-rows outcome when duplicate additions are accepted.
Set the requested delivery location on the first product row.
Confirm the first row retains the requested delivery location.
Set the same requested delivery location on the second duplicate row.
Confirm the second row also retains the requested delivery location.
